accounting_boundary: Final reproduction plus retained pre-lock pilots. Development-time editor commands, manuscript compilation, web acquisition, and every unit-test rerun are not represented as a complete all-tools CPU total.
claims: The final scientific reproduction satisfies every frozen execution limit. Resource measurements support closure only, not algorithmic or database-engine performance.
interpretation: The 128-tuple cap is an execution bound. Formula-only depth-seven and larger all-key cases do not claim materialized database execution.
